_comment:
'When this hits, put it into its owner's hand.' Ranger Action - Arrow Attack (ArcaneRising).

TRIGGERED + ON_HIT: the shipped idiom for attack-action hit triggers (dtd/herald_of_ravages_red.json); engine.py:550-560 registers the attack card's triggers and dispatches its abilities once state.combat exists.

RETURN_TO_HAND with NO ref/target/zone falls through to objects=[card] -- the source -- which is exactly 'put IT into ... hand' for the attacking arrow itself (effect_types.py:1501-1555; the handler comment states this default is right for bounce-self cards). to_owner:true makes the destination obj.owner, matching the printed 'its OWNER's hand' literally rather than assuming the controller (for your own attack they coincide, but the printed word is owner).

No ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the text is unconditional over ANY hit, unlike send_packing_yellow whose text names a hero.

Adopter note: batch labels the set 'ArcaneRising'; shipped Arcane Rising cards live in json/arc/ -- pick the folder from the card's own setIdentifiers per IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE step 4.
